review.scope: Finite existing-reader reuse, exact run/data binding and bounded one-case annotation/static-frame projection only. No fourth broad review or new control family.

completed_allocation.scope: Maximum one run artifact-list GET and at most one uniquely eligible native-general-browser ZIP GET; no pagination, logs, status, alternate, refetch or retry.

assessment.transport_reuse: The reader hash-checks and imports the immutable reviewed browser reader definitions, which import the immutable reviewed normal operator definitions. No predecessor main, validate or acquire_normal is called. Existing get/write/load/nodup/ZIP/inflate/raw-name/source-path/fixture-tuple/encoder definitions remain in their frozen files; no transport/archive helper is copied or edited.
assessment.admission: Before output creation or GET, the exact main checkout, source/proposal hashes, completed terminal ownership/title/run/head/attempt and nine completed job conclusions must match. Root capability requires execution_authorized=true, exact fixed mode, maximum two requests, no retry, a fresh operation UUID distinct from checkpoint, bound allocation/source proof/independent PASS evidence and absent exact output path. Template false is inert. Root is the trusted completed-allocation/source-proof producer; this review does not create activation.
assessment.first_GET: Exact repos/rthunborg/Kopplas/actions/runs/39754927821/artifacts?per_page=100; at most 100 entries and 4MiB; pagination/inconsistent shape refuses. Missing native-general-browser closes the unused slot as UNAVAILABLE; duplicate exact-name candidates stop.
assessment.second_GET: Only the unique exact native-general-browser with positive integer ID, fixed run/head, nonexpired flag, valid nullable expiry, size and API SHA256 is durably admitted before its single ID-bound ZIP request. No provider URL from the response is executed. Compressed bytes and SHA256 must match. Only general-browser.json plus safe directories are admitted through retained ZIP/path/symlink/duplicate/CRC/ratio guards.
assessment.intent_and_bounds: Exclusive output and fsynced operator intent precede transport. Imported transport consumes each exclusive intent before request and preserves 15s/native exit/EOF/joined reader/closed handle/settlement safeguards. Failure or uncertainty consumes its slot; there is no retry loop. Caps remain list4MiB, ZIP32MiB, declared/actual aggregate inflate128MiB, selected JSON16MiB, stderr64KiB.
assessment.projection: Only exact source-path/full-title-SHA E2E001 is identity-bound. At most one retry0 result is projected; retry1/malformed scope becomes UNKNOWN, duplicates stop. Scope/count fields disclose extra/missing cases rather than supplying acceptance. Source class is closed; only bounded source-backed coordinates from the two pinned paths and first four of at most16 errors survive, with omission_UNKNOWN for truncation. Frames remain candidates and cause remains UNKNOWN.
assessment.annotation: calendar-original-rotate-post-drain accepts only exact net::ERR_ABORTED, net::ERR_FAILED or UNKNOWN descriptions from bounded test/result annotation containers. Missing is UNKNOWN_MISSING; malformed, conflicting or within-container duplicated records are UNKNOWN_REFUSED. Agreeing records copied across test/result containers retain their recorded sources. No original annotation text is copied.
assessment.privacy: Raw archives/report/errors/messages/titles/stacks/URLs/tokens/DOM/body values remain RAM-only. No arbitrary raw exception is persisted or printed. Fixed enum/status/count fields, title SHA, bound source coordinates and existing closed fixture tuples are the only projected diagnostics.
assessment.publication: The real production projection is encoded once and those exact bytes are exclusively written only if <=32768. The author measured one supported one-case sample at2812 bytes; this is not a universal arbitrary-integer envelope proof. Oversize refuses after consumption and grants no retry.
assessment.limits: A native code, static frame or successful acquisition does not prove abort origin, body linkage, canonical cleanup, key deletion or backend settlement. Report-only wrapper lifecycle/key-deletion fields remain null/UNKNOWN. Ended job and Stop-stack success remain separate limited metadata.
